handoff.salientSummary: Resolved all 14 backend blocking scrutiny findings for milestone foh-core across @repo/reservations, @repo/tenant-db, and apps/tenant-api, re-seeded US (acme) and KSA (riyadh-grill) demo databases with verified non-null schema columns, and verified all unit/route/security suites and live endpoints.
handoff.whatWasImplemented:
1. Wrapped all Setup mutations in apps/tenant-api/src/routes/operator-reservations-setup.ts, services/rsv-setup-service.ts, and services/rsv-setup-crud.ts inside withReservationWrite / withSetupWrite using AsyncLocalStorage transaction context so saveFloorPlan, location settings updates, combo updates, block updates, and turn-time/special-day/section/service mutations run inside a single per-org serialized SQLite transaction and roll back atomically on error (VAL-SETUP-011, VAL-SETUP-017). Also registered PATCH route aliases on /locations/:locationId/{combos,combinations,turn-times,special-days}/:id.
2. Enforced hold-duration bounds (holdMinutes: 3..20, holdTtlSec: 180..1200, paymentHoldMinutes: 10..60, voiceHoldMinutes: 5..30) in packages/reservations/src/schemas/setup.ts, packages/reservations/src/config/{index,validate}.ts, and rsv-setup-service.ts (VAL-SETUP-005).
3. Tightened turn-time minutes bounds to 15..480 in @repo/reservations and rsv-setup-crud.ts, and added non-overlapping [partyMin, partyMax] bucket validation within the same (locationId, serviceId ?? null) scope on create and update (400 overlapping_turn_time_bucket, VAL-SETUP-019).
4. Expanded special-day [fromDate..toDate] ranges on create, update, and delete in rsv-setup-crud.ts and unconditionally bumped rsv_day_versions for every affected date even when closed or when 0 bookings reflow (VAL-SETUP-022).
5. Validated table-combination member sets (distinct >=2 members, existing in location, unarchived, combinable = 1, and non-duplicate canonical member set) in updateComboForLocation and saveFloorPlan combo upserts (VAL-SETUP-010).
6. Updated POST /internal/reservations/location-summary and getLocationReservationsSummary to return { ok: true, orgId, region, locationId, futureReservations, activeFutureReservations, activeReservations, activeWaitlist, activeHolds, tables, canDelete } matching locationReservationsSummarySchema (VAL-BOOK-031).
7. Added GET /operator/reservations/book/conflicts?locationId=&date= returning unassigned bookings and detectConflicts items (VAL-BOOK-012) and added coverage in reservations-security.test.ts.
8. Added GET /operator/reservations/book/reservations/:id/events returning chronological rsv_reservation_events (VAL-BOOK-013) and added coverage in reservations-security.test.ts.
9. Added covers_actual column to rsv_reservations in @repo/tenant-db schema and migrations, updated statusTransitionSchema and transitionReservationStatus to accept covers/coversActual/seatedCovers/arrivedCovers, persisted covers_actual and seated_covers on seating, and incremented rsv_guests.covers by coversActual ?? seatedCovers ?? partySize on finish (VAL-BOOK-017).
10. Enforced contact_statuses_enabled and course_statuses_enabled in updateReservationContactStatus and updateReservationCourseStatus (409 when disabled), preserved exact status values in RSV_CONTACT_STATUS_VALUES and RSV_COURSE_STATUS_VALUES, and registered /reservations/:id/contact-status and /reservations/:id/course-status routes (VAL-BOOK-022, VAL-BOOK-023).
11. Emitted rsv_reservation_events rows with type = 'auto_reassigned' and { fromTableIds, toTableIds } whenever soft reflow moves a reservation in rsv-booking-service.ts (including explicit-table displacement on create) and rsv-setup-service.ts (VAL-HOST-008).
12. Enforced expectedVersion (409 stale_version) in upsertServiceNotes, wrapped upsertServiceNotes and putSectionAssignments in withSetupWrite, accepted unlock/reflowLaterParties/skipPayment/paymentPolicyMode in operator-reservations-book.ts, and hardened validation error helpers against echoing rejected enum values.
13. Fixed apps/tenant-api/scripts/seed-reservations.ts column names (sort, body, updatedBy, arrivedCovers, seatedCovers, coversActual, guestRequests, staffNotes), re-ran seed:reservations for acme and riyadh-grill, and verified non-null values in SQLite.
